summary.text: Mike Oliverio is a Republican state senator from West Virginia who has represented District 13 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A financial advisor and U.S. Army Reserve veteran, he lives in Morgantown.

paragraphs.text: Mike Oliverio lives in Morgantown, West Virginia.
He served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 1987 to 1994, reaching the rank of captain.
He earned a B.S. in business administration and management from West Virginia University in 1985 and a master's degree in the field from the university in 1986.
His career experience includes working as a financial advisor with Northwestern Mutual Life.
Oliverio took office in the State Senate on December 1, 2022, succeeding Robert Beach.

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Interstate Cooperation Committee and the Pensions Committee and also serves on the Banking and Insurance, Economic Development, Education, Finance, and Transportation and Infrastructure committees.
